scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,assessor -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.serve: concurrently -n web,api,assessor -c green,cyan,yellow "node scripts/run-web.js start" "node scripts/run-python.js -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.test: npm run lint:copy && node scripts/run-python.js -m pytest && npm --workspace @mirror/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint:copy && npm --workspace @mirror/web run lint
